text: Cohesive HoTT has a model in the category of:
choices: ∞-sheaves on a cohesive site (like sheaves on smooth manifolds)
explanation: Models of cohesive HoTT include the ∞-topos of ∞-sheaves on a cohesive site (e.g., smooth manifolds, diffeological spaces). The modalities ∫, ♭, ♯ correspond to the cohesive adjoint quadruple.
